manual_validation_gates.name: real P4 mounting pattern
manual_validation_gates.reason: The first printed template moved the outer boss holes 2 mm inward; the next physical fit showed that was 0.5 mm too far. CAD is now corrected to x=7.9/128/248.1 and y=7.9/120.1. Print/re-fit the revised template before accepting structural backplanes.

manual_validation_gates.name: P4 moulded locator clearance
manual_validation_gates.reason: The failed print showed at least one protruding moulded panel locator entering an old provisional slot. The replacement provides 10 mm round clearances at all four old symmetric centres; each clearance deliberately overlaps the frame opening by 1 mm to avoid a tangent/non-manifold edge. Confirm every real locator clears and the panel seats flat.

manual_validation_gates.name: rear component and connector keep-outs
manual_validation_gates.reason: The real-panel scan/photo improve confidence in the rear layout, but the revised backplane must still be physically checked for flat seating, moulded locator clearance and connector/component contact.

manual_validation_gates.name: printed 1 m rod insertion
manual_validation_gates.reason: Nominal CAD uses 6 mm reinforcement bars in 7.2 mm bores (0.6 mm radial clearance), but accumulated FDM tolerance across four modules still requires a physical insertion test.

manual_validation_gates.name: controller and power hardware fit
manual_validation_gates.reason: Exact real-hardware connector, terminal and strain-relief envelopes are not all represented in CAD.

manual_validation_gates.name: split rod-end plug retention
manual_validation_gates.reason: The CAD uses a compressible detent sized for the 7.2 mm reinforcement bore, but FDM shrinkage and filament stiffness require one physical insertion/removal test.

manual_validation_gates.name: MatrixPortal left-side service access
manual_validation_gates.reason: The MatrixPortal is now modelled 63.5 x 44.45 mm in landscape orientation with its 44.45 mm short USB/button edge overhanging Panel 1 by 10 mm. Verify the real board orientation, button/USB finger clearance, and lid/side clearance physically.

manual_validation_gates.name: centre-boss desk stand physical stability
manual_validation_gates.reason: PRINT_3 reduces the boss mounting plate from 5 mm to 3 mm and adds a 15 mm forward toe under the display while retaining the 60 mm rear foot. Verify screw length/thread engagement, anti-rotation lip fit and that two stands no longer tip forward.

manual_validation_gates.name: rear backplane footprint
manual_validation_gates.reason: The physical LED module rear appears 1 mm smaller overall than the front 256 x 128 mm envelope. CAD now uses a centred 255 x 127 mm rear footprint (0.5 mm inset on every edge) while retaining the nominal panel coordinate system and 256 mm module pitch. Confirm the revised backplane seats inside the rear moulding without edge overhang.

manual_validation_gates.name: panel-to-panel seam cable corridor
manual_validation_gates.reason: The seam route is a 24 mm-high notch through only the rear 5 mm of each 16 mm vertical rail, preserving an 11 mm panel-facing structural web. Verify the real flat HUB75 ribbon crosses naturally without pinching against the web, seam straps or alignment tongues.

manual_validation_gates.name: snap-on rear lid fit and retention
manual_validation_gates.reason: Lid peg centres now exactly equal the four backplane socket centres in the same XY coordinate system. PETG is preferred for repeated flexing. Verify real snap force, removal force, electronics clearance, MatrixPortal side access, ventilation and cable egress.

manual_validation_gates.name: panel mounting screw-well fit
manual_validation_gates.reason: Each panel mount has a 10 mm diameter rear counterbore leaving 5 mm of local plastic. Verify the actual screw head fits inside the recess, remains below the rear/lid plane, and still provides safe thread engagement in the panel boss without bottoming out.

measured_panel_geometry.source: calibrated 1:1 ruler photograph cross-checked with Kiri Engine scan, then corrected by two physical template fits (first +2 mm inward from all edges, second 0.5 mm back outward)
measured_panel_geometry.physical_fit_status: second physical fit showed the first inward correction was 0.5 mm too far; CAD now uses x=7.9/128/248.1 and y=7.9/120.1, pending another physical re-fit
measured_panel_geometry.rear_backplane_fit_note: Physical LED module rear moulding appears 1 mm smaller overall than the 256 x 128 mm front envelope; CAD keeps the 256 x 128 coordinate system/pitch but insets the printed backplane 0.5 mm on every edge.

reinforcement_bar.note: Bar centre positions are unchanged from the previous 8 mm-bar design.

seam_cable_corridor.note: The shallow rear notch is sized for the width of a flat 16-way HUB75 ribbon while preserving an 11 mm panel-facing structural web. PRINT_4 joiner straps remain above/below the notch.

rear_lid.note: Lid and backplane now share the same XY coordinate system. The printed lid footprint matches the 255 x 127 mm backplane footprint and its peg centres are exactly the socket centres.

panel_mount_screw_wells.note: Rear counterbores reduce the required screw length and keep normal M3/M4 screw heads below the 16 mm rear surface so they do not interfere with the lid.

matrixportal_geometry.service_edge: Panel 1 outside/left SHORT edge (44.45 mm edge) containing USB-C and Reset/Up/Down/Boot
matrixportal_geometry.note: The board was previously modelled portrait, which exposed its long edge. It is now rotated so the physical short control edge faces the enclosure side.

interface_audit.panel_mount_template: Template and structural backplane both use panel_mount_x/panel_mount_y and panel_locator_x/panel_locator_y from direct_mount_enclosure.scad.
interface_audit.seam_joiner: PRINT_4 screw rows are local y=9/51 at installed y=34, giving global y=43/85 to match backplane joiner inserts.
interface_audit.electronics_carriers: MatrixPortal and power carriers use local [6/238,6/66] holes; installed offsets align them with backplane accessory inserts.
interface_audit.rear_lid: Snap pegs and sockets use identical global XY centres [64/192, 8/120].
interface_audit.desk_stand: Installed stand origin x=112 places its local x=16 screw at lower-centre panel boss x=128; y comes directly from panel_mount_y[0].
interface_audit.rod_plug: Rod plug is concentric with the 7.2 mm reinforcement bore; retention remains a physical tolerance test.
interface_audit.cable_clip: Independent accessory; no fixed backplane mating coordinate is assumed.
interface_audit.mounting_coupon: Calibration coupon reproduces insert pocket geometry but has no assembly position.
